_note: Concurrency-sweep at FIXED scale (the scale-ramp's peak operating region). Concurrency is the only moving variable (per the calibration rule: scale ramp first -> freeze the plateau scale -> sweep concurrency here). ARMS semantics: bounded_http/duckdb_ai 'concurrency' is PER-ENDPOINT (gate concurrency_per_endpoint; C_total = 2*concurrency); project_static 'concurrency' is the per-endpoint K (max_inflight; C_total = 2*K) and is capped by actor_workers_per_endpoint*ray_actor_max_concurrency (= slots; K must be <= slots). lb_rr is NOT swept here -- it needs the endpoint_count=1 manifest + C_total semantics and is done in the lb_rr scale-ramp (Phase 1b). Run AFTER the cap gate (cap=64 frozen) and AFTER the scale ramp picked this scale as the peak region. warmup_per_cell runs bounded_http on the manifest at warmup_concurrency on BOTH endpoints before each measured cell so the shared prefix cache is hot regardless of arm/order (deploy 9.1 #4).
